messages:
elaine-partnerships: Quick heads-up: we hit repeated OOMs on MI300 eu-central during long-context evals (rebel-13b@v3, seq=8192). Looks like KV cache growth. Need a short cross-org mitigation: routing fallback, marketplace SKU hint, SI test window before next week's demos.

ken-eng: Can you paste minimal repro and error text?

elaine-partnerships: Repro: rebel-13b@v3, seq=8192, batch=2 on mi300-eu-03. Log: "GPU OOM during KV-append at step 410".

sam-platform: Short-term plan: routing policy "mi300-eu-fallback" (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%) to route that model id to H100/H200 hosts; marketplace non-breaking suggestion to surface fallback SKUs in EU; SI window Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC for vendor RC tests.

jules-cloud: I'll draft the marketplace PR. Proposed mapping: rebel-13b -> eu: [H100-XL, H200-STD]. Holding until SI window confirmed.

vendor-mi300: Acknowledged. We reproduce and will supply RC binary in ~48h. Short-term: set gpu_mem_guard=0.85 and avoid quant images for canary.

vendor-gaudi: We'll run a 24h parity long-seq test if you share commit/tag. No regressions on our side so far.

ken-eng: Also adding runtime soft-fallback: prefer H100 kernel when seq_len>4096 for rebel-13b (config toggle). Need perf/cost delta vs H100 for comms.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-999: "MI300 EU long-seq KV-cache OOM". Runbook link internal.

sam-platform: Action owners: @sam-platform routing + PR, @ken-eng runtime toggle + perf eval, @jules-cloud marketplace timing, vendors RC & tests. Reconvene in 48h or when RC lands. :thumbsup:
